decisions.decision: Counter shows `2/3 min` under the minimum, `3/32` once met
decisions.rationale: User asked for '3 min 32 max' but the slot is inside the field box, nowrap, and repeats per column row. The error prose is sr-only whenever a counter owns the slot, so the counter is the only constraint signal a sighted user gets — a bare `/3` on a field accepting 32 reads as a maximum.

decisions.decision: Delete bare D/S/U/GC decision ids from comments; keep T-NN-NN and the 20 requirement ids
decisions.rationale: Measured per family rather than assumed: 37 of 74 decision ids are defined in more than one phase document and D-01 in nine, so a bare one names nothing. T-NN-NN carries its phase inside the token and requirement ids are defined once each in ROADMAP.md — both already resolve. An earlier pass swept all six families and would have erased the only record of which acceptance criterion each e2e spec proves.

style-dictionary.config.mjs asserted 'Tailwind v4 has no composite type', which the docs contradict. That wrong belief cost every one of 62 sites a hand-rolled font-weight and dropped line-height entirely. Closes WINDOWS.md window 2, open since 2026-08-11.

decisions.decision: Land the full-app smoke but keep it and smoke:check OUT of CI
decisions.rationale: User's call. The sustaining mechanism is proven (smoke:check caught SYNC-01 on its first run); the spec is not. Wiring an unexplained intermittent failure into CI trains people to ignore a red build.

decisions.decision: Vitest V8 coverage with no thresholds, pinned at 4.1.10
decisions.rationale: A threshold picked before the first measurement either gates nothing or blocks the build on day one. 4.1.11 warns about mixed versions against the pinned vitest.

context_notes: Working tree is clean and the full suite is green at 2023/2023 in 173s, with all 13 static gates passing. The session's throughline was that FOUR separate detectors lied — `lastIndexOf('<button')` landing on a neighbouring element, `elementFromPoint` returning null off-viewport, a grep missing a backtick, and `/disabled/` matching Tailwind's `disabled:opacity-50` class. Two nearly caused wrong conclusions: one almost made me revert a working hydration fix, and a `| tail -20` pipeline reported a FAILING visual suite as exit 0. Prove a detector fires on a state where the thing must be present before trusting its silence.
